caption: Ever notice your stomach making noise when you're hungry? What do you usually do when that happens?
comments_seeded: I've always wondered if those sounds mean my body is really ready for food
Sometimes I eat a little something to quiet it down, but maybe that's not the best idea
Do you find that drinking water helps calm your stomach before eating?
It's interesting how our bodies can be so different, some people's stomachs seem to be louder than others
What's the weirdest time your stomach has ever growled - was it during a meeting or in a quiet room?
